run_adsorbml: run the AdsorbML pipeline to relax a slab with an adsorbate using a pretrained ML calculator
adsorb_ml_pipeline: run the ML-based adsorbate-slab pipeline to generate, relax, and validate adsorbate-slab configurations
ocp_adslab_generator: generate multiple adsorbate-slab configurations from a slab structure and list of adsorbates
detect_anomaly: detect anomalies like dissociation, desorption, surface change, or intercalation between initial and final atomic structures
reference_adslab_energies: reference adsorbate-slab energies to atomic and slab reference energies to compute adsorption energy
